description: Stream v2 on spawn.host.ctl: base64 JSON chunks of exactly chunk_bytes (8192) but the last, a negotiated window of unacknowledged chunks starting at 16 or fewer, cumulative stream.ack in both directions (the daemon acknowledges what it wrote), resumable by a device-chosen id with one status shape {id} -> {state, received, next_sequence}, a digest at the start or the end, and daemon-side pacing of bulk streams on the DataChannel's buffered_amount. proto/README.md, 'Stream v2', is the specification; conv.v1 (daemon D2) is its first user and fs.v2 (D4) adopts it. Nothing implements it yet. The transcripts carry the bytes of the three-chunk bundle in conversation-bundle-v1-vectors.json; their conv.* payload fields beyond the stream's own are illustrative until D2 specifies them.

transcripts.name: a write resumed after the channel closed (conv.import.begin)
frames: the channel closes before chunk 2 is sent; the staged transfer stays resumable

transcripts.name: a read with its digest at the end, resumed (conv.export)
frames: the channel closes; the device keeps the 16384 bytes it acknowledged
